laboratory_rules: Roll once to reveal two pairs. Choose one whole pair and confirm it. Play those two dice using the usual Dice Chess rules. You can choose a pair with no legal move; that passes the turn. Your choice is final once confirmed.
laboratory_eyebrow: A different rhythm of Dice Chess
laboratory_lead: Try something new at a familiar board. Start a game and invite a friend.
laboratory_mode_description: Two pairs to choose from. The usual rules for moves.
laboratory_invite_lead: Send this link to the person you want to play. It opens their seat at your table.
laboratory_manual_copy: Select the link and copy it manually.
laboratory_seat_assignment: You have {mine}. Your friend will play {theirs}.
laboratory_clock_note: Clocks start when you are both ready. For now, take your time sharing the invitation.
laboratory_running_note: The game clock keeps running through a reconnect. Keep this tab open.
laboratory_join_title: A seat is waiting for you.
laboratory_join_lead: One friend. Two rolls. Choose a pair and see where the game takes you.
laboratory_closed_body: This invitation is no longer available. Create a new game to try again with your friend.
laboratory_invalid_title: This link can't open a seat.
laboratory_invalid_body: Ask your friend for the complete invitation link, or start a new game.
laboratory_occupied_body: This browser already holds the other seat at this table. Send the invitation to your friend, or open it in a separate browser. Your existing seat has been kept.
laboratory_incompatible_body: The server couldn't confirm this two-pair experiment. No invitation has been issued. Please try again later.
laboratory_unavailable_body: We couldn't open this table. The laboratory may be closed to new games. Please try again later.
laboratory_connection_body: Check your connection and try again. Your seat and the latest game state have been kept.
laboratory_waiting_board: Your friend is on their way.
laboratory_finished_note: This game has finished. Start a new experiment with your friend whenever you like.
laboratory_waiting_board_note: Keep your table open. The server will confirm when you are both ready.
laboratory_ready_board_note: Your game has started. Keep this tab open.
laboratory_keep_link: Browser storage is unavailable. This page's address is your private board link; keep it to return to your seat. Share only the invitation link with your friend.
laboratory_page_title: Dice Chess Lab — Two rolls. One choice.
laboratory_page_description: A private Dice Chess experiment for two friends. Roll two pairs, choose one, and play. No bots or ratings.
